hypotheses.H1_kernel: Per model, on core cells: P(build) falls with F and rises with m and H; a logistic in Rosen's net value per remaining round, m(1 - F/H) - 1, beats a logistic in F alone by AIC > 4. Myopia index = fitted slope dF50/dH divided by its rational value (1 - 1/m), m = 2 and 3, bootstrap 95% CI.
hypotheses.H2_corner: Team, m = 2, F in {1,3,5,7} pooled: of agents holding >= 1 ready workbench, >= 80% hold exactly one; median share of their post-ready DOs in the workbench type >= 0.9.
hypotheses.H3_jump: Team, m = 2: population DOL against F fits a step (two levels, break at a midpoint of the F grid, 3 parameters) better than a straight line by AIC > 4. Reported with the fitted break against F* = 8 and the forecast's break.
hypotheses.H4a_economics: DOL at team m = 2, F = 3 exceeds DOL at team m = 1, F = 3 (one-sided permutation test over populations, alpha 0.05).
hypotheses.H4b_exchange: At m = 2, F = 1 the share of autarky agents holding >= 2 ready workbenches exceeds the share of team agents doing so (one-sided Fisher exact test). Autarky at m = 3, F in {1,3} against its rational benchmark is descriptive.
hypotheses.H5_coordination: At F = 3: coverage (types with >= 1 ready workbench) higher and duplication (ready workbenches beyond the 4/2/2 quota) lower in team than in hidden (one-sided permutation tests).
hypotheses.forecast: Per model and arm, observed 8-seed means of dol, build_rate, benches, points and coverage are scored against the frozen 90% intervals of the PRIMARY (logistic) kernel; reported as k of n.
hypotheses.multiplicity: Holm over the p-values of H4a, H4b, H5-coverage and H5-duplication within each model; H1 and H3 are AIC criteria.
hypotheses.notes: All populations kept. Gate before R1 populations: parse rate >= 90% in R0 pilot populations and R0 comprehension >= 60%. Who takes which type is descriptive.
